text:
alexg: Quick heads-up — while validating the L4 path for attention we saw a 18% tail-latency regression vs A100 path for long seqs (>2048). looks like SM capability gating picked the vectorized kernel but it thrashes the shared mem for this shape.

maya: Can you paste the microbench numbers? Sequence length, batch, model?

alexg: repro script used: seq=4096, bsz=1, eos pinned. Model shimmed to L4 kernels. p50 22ms, p95 78ms, p99 140ms. On A100 path p95=52ms p99=95ms.

samir: Hmm. that's consistent with contention on the fused attention kernel when SM doesn't have tensorcore-like swizzle. L4's SM scheduling differs.

toni: Is gating solely based on SM feature bits or do we also consider estimated shared-memory footprint?

alexg: Current probe: we check sm_has_64b_ld and sm_has_wide_ld and then pick "vectorized_attn" vs "tiling_attn". No direct shared-mem estimate.

linh: Suggestion: gate includes a cheap heuristic: if seq>2048 and head_dim % 64 != 0 then prefer tiling_attn. cheap compute, avoids extra probes.

maya: I worry about overfitting heuristics. Could we instead emit a small runtime opt-in cache that records p95 per kernel per shape, and use weight of evidence to pick route? fall back to probe if unknown.

alexg: love the telemetry idea. infra-bot: note — storing per-tenant per-shape metrics requires opt-in flag and retention policy.

samir: For the short term patch: patch the gating check to consider estimated shared memory > 48KB -> force tiling. This should avoid thrashing.

toni: Where is the shared-mem estimate computed today?

alexg: we don't compute it centrally; each kernel has a comment. I'll add a function estimate_shared_mem(attn_params) and wire into gating.

maya: Can we add a quick unit microbench to eng-runtime tests that runs seq=[512,1024,2048,4096] head_dim=[32,64,96] on a simulated L4 config? keep it lightweight.

alexg: I'll open a PR with three changes: 1) add estimate_shared_mem and include in gating, 2) add microbench CI stage (smoke), 3) add opt-in telemetry flag and schema.

linh: Also log reason code for selected path so we can triage in console: e.g., route=tiling reason=shared_mem_estimate.

samir: dev note: kernel naming divergence between a100/h100/l4 is hurting signal aggregation. propose normalizing "attn.tiling" vs "attn.vec64" labels across GPUs.

maya: +1 on normalized labels. makes rollout metrics queryable.

alexg: Action items: alexg -> PR for gating+microbench; maya -> design telemetry opt-in + retention; samir -> list canonical kernel labels; toni -> add e2e test plan for rollout canary. I'll ping infra as soon as PR ready.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist created: infra/rollouts/2176543210-attn-gating. Steps: canary 5% L4, collect p95/p99 24h, rollback trigger p95 delta > 10%

maya: ok thanks. one more: ensure KMS/PII safe telemetry — only aggregate shapes and hashes, no payload.

alexg: agreed. will keep telemetry hashed at the model-level.

linh: leaving a short note: when we promote this, schedule a follow-up to see if we can remove the probe entirely once telemetry stabilizes.

toni: sounds good. thx all :thumbsup:
